page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at the top. Above the heading, a block of three short italic paragraphs. Then chapter heading 17 and two paragraphs of text. Catchword at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

p.i: Integra nobis corda custodi ab Hypocriseos larva, nec jam eadem precantibus, aut Te laudantibus voce illa Davidica aut aliorum sanctorum, quicquam nobis deterius evenit.
Da nobis Sapientiam, ut quae intus sint prava corrigamus, minus erit jam extra emendandum.
Libera semper Ecclesiam tuam, & immunem præsta his malis quæ cæcitatem zeli & audacem pietatem consequuntur.

main_text.head: 17. De controversiis inter Regem & utramque Domum Parlamenti in Disciplina Ecclesiastica.
main_text.p: REgimen Ecclesiæ per Episcopos quòd eâ semper pertinaciâ defenderim, ea erat plurimorum suspicio me non vera pietate id facere, sed Politicis rationibus adductum.
Nec sanè diffiteor, eousque apud me valere Rationes Politicas, ut hoc Regimen aliis anteponam, quatenus mihi jam diu exploratum est

page.notes: The catchword "Regi" is at the bottom right. The right edge of the scan shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The initial "R" of "REgimen" is a large initial. The Greek running head is set in capitals; the letter shapes were read as printed (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ). No printing errors are marked.
